headline: Clinton order sets up an advisory committee on high-performance computing, information technology, and the Next Generation Internet.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order creates an advisory committee to give the federal government outside advice on high-performance computing and communications, information technology, and the Next Generation Internet. No summary was provided, so details such as who serves on the committee and what it must report are not available here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that fund computing and internet research
who_it_affects.how: They would receive advice from the committee on computing, communications, and internet research programs.

who_it_affects.group: Experts from industry and universities in computing and networking
who_it_affects.how: People from these fields may be named to serve on the advisory committee.

when_it_takes_effect: 1997-02-11 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in the source)
